src: each non-wall monochrome domino object s
path: straight toward the complete red edge wall, perpendicular to that edge, stopping when the next step would hit the wall, a settled domino, or the grid boundary
trajectory: move s rigidly to its stopped endpoint, preserving shape and color
transform: clear s.old cells to background; keep the red edge wall unchanged
multi_step: settle dominoes nearest the wall first so farther dominoes stack behind them
